done.why: I found a treasure, the painting, and put it in the trophy case, which was my goal.

about: A reworked Zork. You enter the white house, go down the trap door past a troll to a gallery and studio, and bring treasure back to the trophy case.

ending.what: The painting is in the trophy case. No formal ending text appeared.

moments.note: The trap door crashed shut and was barred behind me.
The troll fell in two sword blows and vanished in black fog.
The east passage was blocked by a note: Back soon. -- The Management.
The trap door was locked from above, so I could not go back up the way I came.
The studio chimney led back up to the kitchen.

wished: A hint about how to get back up from the cellar
More of the unfinished passages to explore

lines.line: The passage to the east has not been finished. A note is pinned to the rock: "Back soon. -- The Management."
lines.why: A funny, unexpected way of closing off an exit.

fun.why: Quick, clear goal and I met it.

engagement.why: It was short, with some blocked exits.

difficulty.why: Easy, apart from the trap door that locked behind me.

interestingness.why: The twists on the classic were fun to find.
